items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...with Eddie South back in 1933... [INTERVIEWEE] We rehearsed down in the basement... [INTERVIEWER] You would build a show around Eddie South. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah... I'd get the music... we'd make -- I'd get the music

ctx.x: Yeah, he owned the theatre and he hired me as musical director. All I had to do was take the music that they brought in and orchestrate it and rehearse the girls with the producer, rehearse the show girls or the dancing girls.
And you tell them what you did there, Tom, because I did some of those things with you, with Eddie South back in 1933, it was down in the basement, wasn't it. You tell it.

We rehearsed down in the basement. They used to have a nightclub there before and I used to play there with that guy that had a trombone. Brownie, remember Brownie, Trombone Brown, he had the band there and I was his piano player and you know, we'd have to go downtown to these hotels and play a show and the man says it's a benefit and one day I went down there and there they had a car, you know,
